limitations: Two known and symptom-selected defects across distinct projects are not a held-out validation corpus.
Test helper uses transparent tqdm_class rather than upstream default progress renderer.
This 2020 defect originally documented on Python 3.6.9 was tested here on Python 3.8.18.
No original BugsInPy project test suite executed.
No evidence yet that any test prioritization policy outperforms baselines on real software.

quality_incident.hypothesis: stale shared Python bytecode cache during in-place commit checkout (not independently proven)
quality_incident.correction: separate git worktrees per revision, disable .pyc, run three fresh repetitions
quality_incident.scope: No performance claims until corrected CI and postmerge run pass
quality_incident.validation_result: All three fresh separate-worktree runs: buggy [0,1,2], fixed [42,43,44]
quality_incident.root_cause_note: Shared Python bytecode cache was a plausible mechanism; mitigation worked, but root cause not isolated experimentally
